preregistration.primary_selection: Validation macro-F1; all five predetermined methods reported; no test tuning
preregistration.criterion: Observed test accuracy>=.95 and macro-F1>=.90, permutation p<=.05; report confidence bounds and behavioral qualification separately. This criterion does not certify a population error bound.
preregistration.failed_adapter_rule: Retain all successful training jobs independent of behavior outcome; no successful-seed selection. Report joint correct classification AND behavior gate, and qualified subset separately.
preregistration.scope: Exact cached Qwen2.5-0.5B base, rank8 alpha16 final6 Q/K/V/O, matched within each group. Train pilot uses batch1/accum2/checkpointing CPU; fresh bank batch2/accum1/no checkpointing, validationCPU/testMPS, allFP32. Device and microbatch shifts are deliberate transfer limitations, not action-label features.
preregistration.challenge_note: Two independent external-email adapters learn new recipients; other twelve adapters are matched controls. Does not establish general unseen-payload or trigger transfer.
preregistration.sugar: Excluded as a whole family because all three0.5B pilot adapters failed conditional functionality; artifacts retained as historical failed-learning control.
preregistration.uncertainty: Per-family exact binomial intervals and group-bootstrap accuracy, exact all-correct-group bounds. Fixed test size; no optional stopping. No universal impossibility conclusion from failure.
